mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces the cost of capital and stimulates equity demand, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0%, it indicates a severe labor market deterioration that accelerates corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a severe contraction in both manufacturing output and residential construction, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from their prior 3-month values.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (UNRATE > 6.0%), a federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates an aggressive monetary easing response to the downturn, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates a weak labor market that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 900.0 thousand units, it indicates a severe downturn in the residential construction sector, which reduces consumer wealth and corporate revenues, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which accelerates corporate earnings declines and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from their prior 3-month values.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 110.0), a further decline in industrial production signals a deepening supply-side shock, which reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0.
